$:/plugins/crosseye/invoice-importer/imp.text:
<$let panel="$:/plugins/crosseye/json-convert/ui/consumer-panel">
<$list filter="[<panel>is[tiddler]] [<panel>is[shadow]] +[first[]]" variable="_jc" emptyMessage="""
This importer needs the ''JSON Convert'' runtime plugin (version 0.11.0 or newer), which is not installed in this wiki.  Drag [[the $:/plugins/crosseye/json-convert tiddler|https://crosseye.github.io/TW5-JSON_Convert/#%24%3A%2Fplugins%2Fcrosseye%2Fjson-convert]] into this wiki, save, and reload.
""">
<$transclude
  $tiddler=<<panel>>
  $mode="block"
  pack="$:/plugins/crosseye/invoice-importer/importer"/>
</$list>
</$let>
$:/plugins/crosseye/invoice-importer/imp.author: Scott Sauyet
$:/plugins/crosseye/invoice-importer/imp.description: Paste the JSON export from the invoice scanner below, or drop the file on the box. Each invoice becomes a tiddler titled by its invoice number.

$:/plugins/crosseye/invoice-importer/rea.title: $:/plugins/crosseye/invoice-importer/readme
$:/plugins/crosseye/invoice-importer/rea.text:
! Invoice Importer

Imports Example Reified Output JSON as tiddlers

* [[Import Invoices|$:/plugins/crosseye/invoice-importer/importer]] — open the importer.  It is also listed under ''More › Importers'' in the sidebar.
* It expects JSON records with the fields `page`, `fields`.
* How to use it: [[Using an importer|$:/plugins/crosseye/json-convert/usage]].
* Version 0.5.2, made 2026-09-28 with [[JSON Convert Studio|https://crosseye.github.io/TW5-JSON_Convert/]].  Needs the JSON Convert runtime 0.11.0 or newer.  If your JSON stops fitting, ask whoever made this importer for a regenerated copy.
